$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: qc_gradient
title: qc.gradient.tsv
description: Identification rate across the gradient: one row per searched file and retention-time bin, ten equal-width bins per file over its own first and last scan start time. Headline numbers of the same bins are in qc.tsv.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, as it appears in qc.tsv.

fields.name: bin
fields.description: Zero-based bin index in retention-time order, 0 to 9.

fields.name: rt_start_min
fields.description: Start of the bin, in minutes. Bin edges divide the file's own retention-time span into ten equal widths, so they differ between files.

fields.name: rt_end_min
fields.description: End of the bin, in minutes; the last bin includes its end.

fields.name: ms2_acquired
fields.description: Spectra of MS level 2 or above whose scan start time falls in the bin.

fields.name: ms2_identified
fields.description: Those spectra carrying a rank-1 target PSM at the q_value threshold of qc.tsv, binned by the PSM's retention time.

fields.name: ms2_identified_pct
fields.description: 100 * ms2_identified / ms2_acquired, zero when the bin acquired nothing.

fields.name: ms1_spectra
fields.description: MS1 spectra in the bin; zero when the search did not read MS1.

fields.name: ms1_tic
fields.description: MS1 total ion current summed over the bin, defined as in qc.tsv; zero when the search did not read MS1.
